title: 第5章 明夫人
content_zh:
第5章明夫人
“喵嗷——”
那猫灵似乎在寻找什么，一双死寂可怖的异瞳四处逡巡，身形轻轻一跃，就带起滚滚阴风。看它翔跃的方向，正是明府后宅。
楚梁自然不会容它向前，如此怨气深重之物，留在世间必要害人。
“御剑术！出！”
戟指朝天，飞剑化作流光已然掠去。
“嗷呜——”
剑光刚一发出，那猫妖便怪叫一声，异瞳瞥向楚梁，身形一窜化作黑影，躲过飞剑，紧接着返身就是一扑！
这一击是对楚梁一剑的报复，来得又快又狠，携着滔天血气，凶猛凌厉！
楚梁将身一闪，也堪堪避过这一扑。但饶是如此，他的衣衫仍旧出现了一丝破口。
猫灵的身形落地，划出两道血色的痕迹。
但一道剑光如影随形，已然跟了上来！是楚梁的飞剑！
剑光迅速划过，猫灵的身躯竟突然歪折成了一个诡异的弧度，躲过了这致命的一剑，“嗷——”
躲过了，但没完全躲过。
剑光仍旧在猫灵身上划出了一道深深的伤口。
霎时间，那伤口中涌现出黑色的血气，瞬间让猫灵周围的血浪更加汹涌！
楚梁眉头一皱。
这只叠满了特殊加持的猫灵，身上有着婴灵的特性。即受到的伤害都会转化为它新的力量，受伤越重，实力越强！如果一剑没有斩杀它，那就要做好准备面临更强的敌人！
反应在这只猫灵身上，就是它的速度变得更快了！
几乎是一道肉眼不可见的黑光，划出两道闪电，下一秒已经来到了楚梁的背后。

楚梁已经是第一时间做出反应，将飞剑召回握在手中，可再无论如何，也是防不住背后的！
发丝倒竖，虽然无声无息，但他知道猫灵的利爪马上就要落下！
千钧一发之际，楚梁右手陡然一松，喝道：“着！”
一道红光如灵蛇一般从袖中窜出，将刚刚到楚梁背后准备出爪的猫灵瞬间捆了个结实。
龟甲缚！
缚妖绳！
“喵嗷——”猫灵凄厉一叫，但身躯无法控制地坠落在地。
对付敏捷特别高的敌人，什么最好用？
而楚梁的手中，恰好有前日刚刚获得的缚妖绳。
可即使有法宝，也并非必中。他也正是为了在更近距离施展缚妖绳，才兵行险招，让这猫灵近身。
若是放出缚妖绳的速度慢上丝毫，此战结局就要反转。若是没有沉住气，距离不够，可能法宝也会被猫灵躲避。
无论如何，是他赢了。翻过身信手一挥，剑起剑落。
一剑斩妖。
灵体无形，一旦被斩杀了就什么也留不下来。只有一道金色虚影，荧荧飘落到楚梁身上。
尘埃落定。
短暂但凶险的一场战斗，比之前日里那蜘蛛精，这只叠满了特殊的猫灵显然更难对付。
长出一口气，没等他去通知，就听那边传来凌乱的脚步声，一众明家下人在明员外的带领下都跑了出来。
“哎呀，楚少侠威武！”
“我就说楚少侠一定行的。”
“楚少侠太厉害了，几下就斩杀了这邪祟！”

“……”
七嘴八舌的奉承声响了起来。
楚梁看着这庆功的队伍，也惊讶于他们的突然消失与出现怎么都如此娴熟。
翌日清晨。
歇息了一夜的楚梁，神清气爽地醒来。洗漱完毕之后，有丫鬟来叫，说明员外已经备好宴席，给楚少侠庆功。
“我随后便到。”楚梁温声答道。
然后，他在后院转了转，绕过回廊，走到了一间华丽的房门前。那里，是明员外与夫人的卧房。
笃笃笃，他敲响了房门。
“谁？”里面响起一个柔柔的女子声音。
“在下楚梁，听闻夫人身体不适，特来探视一番。”他答道。
“……”里面沉默了一下，才说道：“是蜀山派的楚少侠啊，眼下我不方便见客，好意心领了，还请回吧。”
与热情的明员外截然不同，这明夫人的声音中透着冷淡。
“在下有蜀山秘法，说不定能对夫人的病症有效。我可以在此稍候，等夫人方便再来探视。”
顿了顿，就听一阵脚步声，接着有人吱呀一下
明夫人看上去神情困倦，未施脂粉，一身家居锦袍。但仍旧肤质白皙，容颜清丽，果然是个美人。
她引楚梁来到屋内屏风前坐下，光线有些暗，她引燃一支红烛，又斟了两杯茶，这才道：“我无非就是受了些惊吓，昨夜楚少侠既然除了那妖物，我转日便好了，也不劳你多费心。”
“如此便好。”楚梁点点头，又道：“不过关于昨夜那猫灵……也有些事情想对夫人讲。”
“哦？”明夫人蹙眉，“楚少侠想讲什么？”
“也不过是一些猜测……”楚梁缓缓说道：“因为昨夜那猫灵颇为奇怪，既是怨灵、还是妖灵、又是婴灵，也令我颇为好奇。所以我就想，它来到你们明府是为了什么……”
“邪祟害人，还需要理由吗？”明夫人道。

“也是需要的，如果是怨灵，先寻找的肯定是害死自己的人……如果是婴灵，最先寻找的，就会是自己的母亲……”楚梁继续道：“而这猫灵在你们明府，连续三日逐渐向前，却没有害一个人，就好像是在找什么东西……”
“找什么？”明夫人的目光似乎有些不善。
“我也在想，明员外说你们家是积善之家，向来不会残害动物。那……它是不是就在找自己的娘亲？可它是妖灵，它的娘亲是不是也是妖？”
“而自那猫灵现身，府中一直不敢露面的，夫人……似乎只有你。”楚梁的目光温润，看向明夫人的眼睛。
明夫人嗤笑一声，“楚少侠不会说我是妖吧？”
“是与不是，一试便知。”楚梁道。
“你有照妖镜？”明夫人眉峰一耸，似乎并不相信。
要世间妖魔显形，要么就是它们主动施展妖法，便会泄露妖气；要么就是有特殊的神通法门，但楚梁的修为还不够修习；要么就是专门的法器，最有名的，就是照妖镜。
只是照妖镜极为稀少，据传人间王朝皇宫有一块，佛门云阙寺有一块，蜀山派确实也有一块。但会不会让一个小弟子带下山，这件事十分存疑。
“不是。”楚梁摇摇头，“但是差不多。”

Chapter 5 Mrs. Ming
"Meow-"
The cat spirit seemed to be looking for something. A pair of deathly and terrifying eyes were wandering around, and with a slight jump of its figure, it brought up the billowing wind. Judging from the direction in which it is flying, it is the back house of the Ming Dynasty.
Chu Liang will naturally not allow it to move forward. If such a resentful thing remains in the world, it will harm others.
"Swordsmanship! Come out!"
The halberd pointed towards the sky, and the flying sword turned into a stream of light and flew away.
"Ouch——"
As soon as the sword light was emitted, the cat demon let out a strange cry, glanced at Chu Liang with strange eyes, and turned into a black shadow, dodging the flying sword, and then turned around and pounced!
This blow was retaliation for Chu Liang's sword. It came fast and hard, with overwhelming blood energy, fierce and fierce!
Chu Liang ducked and barely managed to avoid the attack. But despite this, there was still a slight tear in his clothes.
The cat spirit's figure fell to the ground, leaving two bloody traces.
But a sword light followed him like a shadow, already following him! It’s Chu Liang’s flying sword!
The sword light passed quickly, and the cat spirit's body suddenly bent into a strange arc, avoiding this fatal sword, "Ouch——"
Escaped, but not completely.
The sword light still cut a deep wound on the cat spirit.
In an instant, black blood emerged from the wound, instantly making the blood waves around the cat spirit even more turbulent!
Chu Liang frowned.
This cat spirit, filled with special blessings, has the characteristics of an infant spirit. That is, any damage received will be converted into its new strength. The more serious the injury, the stronger it will be! If one sword fails to kill it, then be prepared to face a stronger enemy!
The reaction to this cat spirit is that its speed becomes faster!
A black light that was almost invisible to the naked eye drew two lightning bolts, and in the next second it had arrived behind Chu Liang.
Chu Liang had already reacted immediately, recalling the flying sword and holding it in his hand, but no matter what, he couldn't guard against what was behind him!
His hair stood on end, and although there was no sound, he knew that the cat spirit's claws were about to fall!
At the critical moment, Chu Liang suddenly loosened his right hand and shouted: "Hold on!"
A ray of red light sprang out from his sleeve like a spiritual snake, and instantly tied up the cat spirit who had just reached Chu Liang's back and was about to claw out his claws.
Tortoise shell binding!
Demon-binding rope!
"Meow-" the cat spirit screamed, but its body fell to the ground uncontrollably.
What's the best way to deal with enemies with particularly high agility?
In Chu Liang's hand, he happened to have the demon-binding rope he had just obtained the day before yesterday.
But even if there is a magic weapon, it is not guaranteed to hit. It was precisely in order to use the demon-binding rope at a closer distance that he made a dangerous move to let the cat spirit get closer.
If the speed of releasing the demon-binding rope is even slower, the outcome of this battle will be reversed. If you don't keep your composure and the distance is not enough, the magic weapon may also be avoided by the cat spirit.
Anyway, he won. He turned over and waved his hand, the sword rose and fell.
Kill the demon with one sword.
The spirit body is invisible, and once it is killed, nothing will remain. There was only a golden shadow floating down on Chu Liang.
The dust has settled.
It was a short but dangerous battle. Compared with the spider spirit from the previous day, this special cat spirit was obviously more difficult to deal with.
He took a deep breath, and before he could notify him, he heard messy footsteps coming from the other side, and a group of Ming family servants ran out under the leadership of Ming Yuanwai.
"Oh, Young Master Chu is so powerful!"
"I said Young Master Chu can definitely do it."
"Young Master Chu is so powerful, he killed this evil spirit in just a few strokes!"
"..."
There was a flurry of flattery.
Chu Liang looked at the celebrating team and was surprised at how skillfully they disappeared and appeared suddenly.
The next morning.
After resting for the night, Chu Liang woke up refreshed. After washing up, a maid came to tell him that a banquet had been prepared to celebrate Young Master Chu's success.
"I'll be there soon." Chu Liang replied warmly.
Then he walked around the backyard and around the cloister,He walked to the door of a gorgeous room. There is the bedroom of Ming Yuanwai and his wife.
Tuk-tuk-tuk, he knocked on the door.
"Who?" A soft female voice sounded inside.
"I'm Chu Liang. I heard that my wife is unwell, so I came here to check on you." He replied.
"..." There was silence for a while, and then he said: "It's Young Master Chu from the Shushan Sect. It's not convenient for me to see guests at the moment, so I accept it kindly, please come back."
Completely different from the enthusiastic Ming Yuanwai, there was a coldness in Mrs. Ming's voice.
"I have the secret method of Shushan, which may be effective for Madam's illness. I can wait here until Madam is convenient to visit again."
After a pause, I heard footsteps, and then someone creaked.
Mrs. Ming looks sleepy, has no makeup, and is wearing a homely brocade robe. But her skin is still fair and her face is beautiful. She is indeed a beauty.
She led Chu Liang to sit in front of the screen in the room. The light was a little dark. She lit a red candle and poured two more cups of tea. Then she said: "I was just a little frightened. Since Young Master Chu got rid of the monster last night, I will be fine the next day. I don't need you to worry too much."
"That's good." Chu Liang nodded and added, "But there are some things I want to tell Madam about the cat spirit last night."
"Oh?" Mrs. Ming frowned, "What does Young Master Chu want to talk about?"
"It's just some speculation..." Chu Liang said slowly: "Because the cat spirit last night was quite strange. It was a resentful spirit, a demon spirit, and a baby spirit, which also made me quite curious. So I thought, why did it come to your Ming Mansion..."
"The evil spirit is harming people, do you need a reason?" Ming Fu said.
"It is also necessary. If it is a resentful spirit, the first thing it will look for is the person who killed you... If it is an infant spirit, the first thing it will look for will be its mother..." Chu Liang continued: "And this cat spirit has been in your Ming Mansion for three consecutive days, gradually moving forward, but not harming anyone, as if it is looking for something..."
"What are you looking for?" Mrs. Ming's eyes seemed a little unkind.
"I'm also thinking that Ming Yuan said that your family is a philanthropic home and never harms animals. So... is it looking for its mother? But it is a demon spirit, is its mother also a demon?"
"And since the cat spirit appeared, the only person in the house who has dared not show up is Madam...it seems you are the only one." Chu Liang looked into Madam Ming's eyes with gentle eyes.
Mrs. Ming sneered, "Young Master Chu won't say I'm a monster, right?"
"Yes or no, you will know once you try it." Chu Liang said.
"Do you have a demon mirror?" Mrs. Ming raised her eyebrows, as if she didn't believe it.
In order for the demons in the world to appear, they either have to actively perform demonic magic, which will reveal the demonic aura; or they have special magical powers, but Chu Liang's cultivation is not enough; or they need special magic weapons, the most famous of which is the demon mirror.
It’s just that demon mirrors are extremely rare. It is said that there is one in the Imperial Palace of the Human Dynasty, one in the Buddhist Yunque Temple, and indeed the Shushan Sect also has one. But whether he would be led down the mountain by a young disciple is very doubtful.
"No." Chu Liang shook his head, "But it's almost the same."
